steps.label: Add baking soda to mug
steps.recipe_text: add-Measure 1/16 teaspoon of baking soda and add it to the mug

steps.label: Add flour to mug
steps.recipe_text: add-Measure 4 tablespoons of flour and add it to the mug

steps.label: Add salt to mug
steps.recipe_text: add-Measure 1/8 teaspoon of salt and add it to the mug

steps.label: Add baking powder to mug
steps.recipe_text: add-Measure 1/8 teaspoon of baking powder and add it to the mug

steps.label: Stir mug contents
steps.recipe_text: Stir-Stir the contents in the mug well

steps.label: Add milk to mug
steps.recipe_text: Add-Add in 3 tablespoons of milk to the mug

steps.label: Add olive oil to mug
steps.recipe_text: Add-1 tablespoon of olive oil to the mug

steps.label: Mix mug contents
steps.recipe_text: Mix-Mix the contents of the mug thoroughly. (There might be some lumps, but that is ok.)

steps.label: Spread sauce on batter
steps.recipe_text: spread-spread marinara sauce around the surface of the batter

steps.label: Sprinkle cheese on sauce
steps.recipe_text: Sprinkle-Sprinkle 1 generous tablespoon of mozzarella cheese on top of the sauce

steps.label: Sprinkle herbs in mug
steps.recipe_text: Sprinkle-Sprinkle dried Italian herbs inside the mug

steps.label: Microwave mug
steps.recipe_text: Microwave-Microwave for 1 minute 20 seconds, or until it rises and the toppings are bubbling
